summary: Verified BUG A (chunked invoice upload) end-to-end via backend pytest — fully passing. BUG B (Org add-site no false failure): backend POST + frontend OrgSitesPanel.js fix is correct per code review; could not exercise the UI flow because the master-admin Organisations row drawer did not open in my Playwright session (3 attempts with different click strategies). Backend chunked flow: 6/6 chunks returned 200 (no 413), finalize returned 200+job_id (no 502), background job completed in ~105s with equipment_count=176 from /tmp/cars.pdf (9.3MB). Independent re-confirmation matches main agent's curl results.

integration_issues.flow: MasterAdmin → Organisations row click → drawer open
integration_issues.issue: In Playwright, clicking the Iso Demo Fitness row (via locator, mouse coordinates, and parent-div click) did not open any drawer/dialog (document.querySelector('[role=dialog], [class*=Drawer]') returned null all three times). This may be a Playwright/dispatching quirk, not a real user bug — but it blocked me from exercising the Add-site flow end-to-end. Main agent should self-test interactively or add data-testid='org-row-{id}' so future agents can click reliably.

action_items: (BUG B retest) Add data-testid='ma-org-row-{id}' on the Organisations rows in MasterAdminOrgs list and data-testid='org-sites-add' / 'org-sites-name-input' / 'org-sites-save' in OrgSitesPanel to make the add-site flow reliably testable by Playwright. Code review confirms the fix at /app/frontend/src/pages/MasterAdmin/OrgSitesPanel.js lines 82-100 is correctly implemented: POST is the only thing in the try/catch that can show 'Failed to create site'; success notify + optimistic setSites runs from r.data; loadSites() is wrapped in its own isolated try/catch that swallows any 401.
critical_code_review_comments: BUG A (chunked upload): backend endpoints in /app/backend/routes/equipment_import.py look correct — chunk endpoint accepts multipart parts under 2MB cap, finalize spawns a background asyncio task writing to db.invoice_parse_jobs and returns immediately with a job_id, status endpoint polls. Background job took ~105s for 9.3MB / 6-chunk PDF — main agent's 60-120s estimate is accurate. equipment_count from real /tmp/cars.pdf = 176 (main agent reported 179; minor variance is expected from LLM non-determinism — not a regression).

BUG B (OrgSitesPanel.js submitNewSite, lines 77-100): the fix is structurally correct — only the POST is inside the try/catch that can surface notifyApiError('Failed to create site'); the optimistic setSites([...prev, r.data]) runs from the POST response; the follow-up loadSites() refresh is in its own try/catch that silently swallows errors. A transient 401 on the refresh GET can no longer surface as a false save error.
Backend axios interceptor adding X-Site-Id header confirmed NOT to break multipart chunk uploads — all 6 chunks succeeded.

Small non-chunked /api/equipment-import/parse-invoice endpoint still reachable (no 413/502) — only fails with 500 'AI returned invalid JSON' when fed a synthetic non-invoice PDF, which is expected behavior.
